name: ABU AL-NAJJAR

bullets.text: Drove the annual ISO/IEC 27001:2022 internal audit across all 127 controls (every clause plus four Annex A domains) to zero nonconformities.
Run SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 evidence operations, remediating and re-evidencing 30-plus controls across authentication, access reviews, AWS configuration, logging, and vulnerability scanning.
Harden AWS through infrastructure as code: enforced IAM access-key rotation and IMDSv2 on EC2, and validated KMS, RDS, and multi-AZ configuration.

Built incident-response processes (alert ingestion, runbooks, on-call, SLO alerts) and contained a spam organization that generated roughly 9,000 invites by correlating IPs from logs into the blocklist.

Brought AI into the workflow: migrated an internal security assistant from ChatGPT to Claude, built an LLM-powered Slack assistant on read-only OneTrust for natural-language compliance queries, and evaluated 11 AI code-review tools.
Completed third-party risk reviews, assessed 35-plus vendors' AI usage and policies, and answered security questionnaires (including HECVAT) for enterprise customers.
Operationalized security monitoring in Datadog and built Slack notification workflows and structured tracking for vulnerabilities and bug bounty items.
Deployed weekly OWASP ZAP baseline scans on production, surfacing ~3-5 findings per scan and routing results into remediation tracking.
Owned the company's bug bounty program (200+ submissions); reduced end-to-end turnaround from weeks (~1 month) to <= 1 week through automation and structured triage.
Built a self-service SSO escalation workflow with automatic revocation checks every 15 minutes; used weekly for just-in-time privileged access while reinforcing least-privilege behavior.
Automated weekly vulnerability scan uploads to Drata to support SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 evidence continuity.

certifications: CompTIA Security+, AI Ready Ohio Certificate, Python/SQL Career Accelerator, Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, OpenSSF Developing Secure Software Certificate
